description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。
description.en: The number of entries per page.

descriptions.zh: - EventTypes必须指定一种事件类型查询，可支持多事件类型同时查询。
descriptions.en: - The required `EventTypes` parameter allows you to specify one or more event types in a single request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-history-events --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --event-types Instance:SystemFailure.Reboot --event-levels WARN --resource-ids i-55qi8m11rr53c4i964md8a00l --event-status Inquiring --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeHistoryEvents --region cn-hangzhou --EventLevels WARN --PageSize 10 --ResourceIds 'i-55qi8m11rr53c4i964md8a00l' --PageNumber 1 --EventStatus Inquiring --EventTypes 'Instance:SystemFailure.Reboot'
